$comment: STORE-CURATED capability profiles ONLY, keyed by appId. This file is NOT a catalog and must never carry version, versionNumber, marketingVersion, packageId, sha256, attest, imageId or any other install-affecting field: the catalog is the live /apps/index.json, fetched at runtime. A baked second catalog is what made the store paint 30 stale rows (11 of them no longer published, 18 of 20 shared rows carrying a stale packageId) before the live fetch replaced them. Guarded by src/capability-profiles.test.mjs, which fails by name if a catalog field reappears here.

pearls.purpose: AI model hub pearl — register Ollama / OpenAI / OpenRouter providers, manage per-model connections, expose AI capabilities to peer Pearls via Grapple. The pearl itself doesn't talk to the public internet directly; one HTTP_COMPONENT sidecar mediates every provider call. Inference transcripts are pinned to the user's Solana wallet so they're tamper-evident and citable across Pearls.

pearls.purpose: The install-admin companion grain for the Cyberteller constellation. Hosts the single ConfigGate Grapple capability every cyberteller grain claims at first launch — hands back the 6 boot env vars (AITX_URL, FINREACT_SIDECAR_URL, FINREACT_TRUST_BUNDLE, FINREACT_CREDIT_PRIVKEY, FINREACT_TEMP_SUSPENSE_GLID, FINREACT_COLD_WALLET_GLID). Admin browser session edits values via HTML form gated on the Sandstorm `admin` permission bit; peer cyberteller grains receive a non-admin Consumer role at share time so they can call getEnv but not setEnv. No external sidecar dependencies.

offers.name: config-gate
offers.purpose: Single Grapple cap claimed by every cyberteller grain in the install. Methods: hello(grainId) -> Greeting (install label + config digest for drift detection), getEnv() -> EnvConfig (read-only, returns the 6 boot env strings + updatedAtMs), setEnv(env) -> digest (admin-bit-gated mutation).
